title: Paulina Zelitsky's sunken city off Cuba and her arrest in Mexico

tellings.quote: So she goes to Mexico to investigate the connection. She's arrested in Mexico severely intimidated by the authorities and sent back to Canada

plain: A researcher named Paulina Zelitsky reported finding a sunken city off western Cuba. When she went to Mexico to look into a link between that city and Mexico, she was arrested, 'severely intimidated by the authorities' and sent back to Canada. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this as what Zelitsky related, and he mentions National Geographic along the way. He tells it as a sign that someone wanted the find left alone.
